plugins.name: replore
plugins.description: The repo scout for vibe coders. Find it before you build it: describe your project in plain words and get the open-source GitHub repos that best fit it, ranked by relevance, popularity and how freely you can use the license, with a plain-English license verdict, the last update, and whether each is safe to build on.
